findings.title: Open user client with dev entitlement
findings.detail: com.apple.developer.driverkit.allow-any-userclient-access is set and NewUserClient performs no caller check, so once loaded any local process can call InitDatapath (chip reset), SendFrame, SetClock and AdjFreq. Accepted for Phase 0 per plan; remove the entitlement before any distribution and consider a single-client guard.

findings.title: Timer not cancelled on Stop
findings.detail: AVBBcmDriver::Stop only calls timer->SetEnable(false), and free() releases the IOTimerDispatchSource and OSAction without Cancel(). Call Cancel in Stop before releasing.

findings.title: Start error paths leave Bus Master on
findings.detail: Start enables Memory+Bus Master before timer creation and RegisterService; those failure branches Close the device without clearing Bus Master or undoing super::Start. Clear Bus Master on every failure exit after setCommandBits.

findings.title: IOReturn name table mislabel
findings.detail: crates/avb-probe/src/iokit.rs kr_check maps 0xe00002ed to kIOReturnNoDevice; that code is kIOReturnNotResponding, and kIOReturnNoDevice is 0xe00002c0. Fix so hardware-test logs are accurate.
